license_required.quote: a person shall not engage in the practice of optometry in this State unless the person has obtained a license pursuant to the provisions of this chapter

type.quote: The Nevada State Board of Optometry, consisting of four members appointed by the Governor, is hereby created.

age_minimum.quote: Is at least 21 years of age

degree_required.value: Doctor of Optometry degree from accredited school
degree_required.quote: Has graduated from a school of optometry accredited or approved by the Board pursuant to NRS 636.135

accrediting_body.value: Board-accredited or nationally recognized accrediting organization
accrediting_body.quote: The Board shall accredit schools, or approve the accreditation of schools by any nationally recognized accrediting organization or agency, in and out of this State teaching the science and art of optometry

exams.name: National Board of Examiners in Optometry (NBEO) comprehensive examination
exams.quote: Has passed each part of the comprehensive national optometry examination administered by the National Board of Examiners in Optometry or its successor

exams.name: Nevada State Board of Optometry examination
exams.quote: Has passed each examination identified, administered or approved by the Nevada State Board of Optometry

interval_years.quote: A license issued under this chapter or any former law must be renewed pursuant to the provisions of NRS 636.250 to 636.285, inclusive, before March 1 of each even-numbered year.

renewal_fee_usd.quote: initial issuance or renewal of a license $1,200

required.quote: The renewal fee must be accompanied by satisfactory evidence that the licensee has, within the immediately preceding 24-month period, completed the required number of hours in a course or courses of continuing education that have been approved by the Board.

hours_per_period.quote: The Board shall not require a licensee to complete more than 40 hours of continuing education during each period of renewal.

value: 2 hours of training in the screening, brief intervention and referral to treatment approach to substance use disorder within 2 years after initial licensure
topical_requirements.quote: The Board shall require each licensee to complete at least 2 hours of training in the screening, brief intervention and referral to treatment approach to substance use disorder within 2 years after initial licensure as part of the continuing education required by subsection 2.

available.quote: The Board may issue a license by endorsement to engage in the practice of optometry to an applicant who meets the requirements set forth in this section.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold valid, active, unrestricted license in another state/territory; no adverse actions in past 5 years; continuously and actively engaged in practice for past 5 years; not held license in Nevada in immediately preceding year; not disciplined or under investigation; not held civilly or criminally liable for malpractice
requirements.quote: An applicant may submit to the Board an application for such a license if the applicant holds a corresponding valid, active and unrestricted license to engage in the practice of optometry in the District of Columbia or any state or territory of the United States.

exists.quote: The Nevada State Board of Optometry, consisting of four members appointed by the Governor, is hereby created.

national_certification.value: National Board of Examiners in Optometry (NBEO) - Treatment and Management of Ocular Disease Examination
national_certification.quote: The successful completion of the "Treatment and Management of Ocular Disease Examination" administered by the National Board of Examiners in Optometry or an equivalent examination approved by the Board

regulatory_model.quote: a person shall not engage in the practice of optometry in this State unless the person has obtained a license pursuant to the provisions of this chapter

credential_type.quote: The Board shall execute a license for each person who has satisfied the requirements of NRS 636.150, 636.155, 636.206 or 636.207

is_mandatory.quote: a person shall not engage in the practice of optometry in this State unless the person has obtained a license pursuant to the provisions of this chapter

title_protection.quote: Advertisement or representation as an optometrist

scope_protection.quote: The acts set forth in this section, or any of them, whether done severally, collectively or in combination with other acts that are not set forth in this section constitute practice in optometry within the purview of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of felony relating to optometry practice or gross misdemeanor involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commission by the licensee of a felony relating to the practice of optometry or a gross misdemeanor involving moral turpitude of which the licensee has been convicted

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud in obtaining license or renewal or in practicing optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commission of fraud by or on behalf of the licensee in obtaining a license or a renewal thereof, or in practicing optometry thereunder.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Alcohol or other substance use disorder
disciplinary_grounds.quote: An alcohol or other substance use disorder.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mental or physical disorder seriously impairing competency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Affliction with any mental or physical disorder or disturbance seriously impairing his or her competency as an optometrist.

disciplinary_grounds.description: False or misleading representations regarding optometric materials or services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making false or misleading representations, by or on behalf of the licensee, with respect to optometric materials or services.
Practice by the licensee, or attempting or offering so to do, while in an intoxicated condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unethical or unprofessional conduct in practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Perpetration of unethical or unprofessional conduct in the practice of optometry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of optometry chapter or regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any violation of the provisions of this chapter or any regulations adopted pursuant thereto.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Operation of medical facility with suspended or revoked license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Operation of a medical facility, as defined in NRS 449.0151, at any time during which the license of the facility is suspended or revoked

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulent, illegal, unauthorized or inappropriate prescribing of controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulent, illegal, unauthorized or otherwise inappropriate prescribing, administering or dispensing of a controlled substance listed in schedule III or IV.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of state or federal law relating to optometry practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any violation of a state or federal law or regulation relating to or involving the practice of optometry

definition_quote.value: The acts set forth in this section, or any of them, whether done severally, collectively or in combination with other acts that are not set forth in this section constitute practice in optometry within the purview of this chapter
definition_quote.quote: The acts set forth in this section, or any of them, whether done severally, collectively or in combination with other acts that are not set forth in this section constitute practice in optometry within the purview of this chapter

value: examination, evaluation, diagnosis and treatment of the human eye and its appendages
measurement of powers or range of human vision
determination of accommodative and refractive states
diagnosis of visual, muscular, neurological, interpretative or anatomic anomalies
measurement, initial fitting, or adaptation of contact lenses
topical use of pharmaceutical agents for diagnosis
prescribing and use of pharmaceutical agents for treatment
removing foreign objects from eye surface
ordering or performing laboratory tests or imaging
methods_authorized.quote: Advertisement or representation as an optometrist. Adapting, or prescribing or dispensing, without prescription by a practitioner of optometry or medicine licensed in this State, any ophthalmic lens, frame or mounting... The examination, evaluation, diagnosis and treatment of the human eye and its appendages... Prescribing, directing the use of or using any optical device in connection with ocular exercises, orthoptics, vision rehabilitation, vision therapy or visual training. The prescribing of contact lenses. The measurement, initial fitting, as defined in NRS 636.387, or adaptation of contact lenses to the human eye... The topical use of pharmaceutical agents... Prescribing, directing the use of or using a pharmaceutical agent or device to treat an abnormality of the eye or its appendages. Removing a foreign object from the surface or epithelium of the eye. Removing eyelashes with forceps. Closing the lacrimal punctum of the eye. The ordering or performing of laboratory tests or imaging to assist in the diagnosis of an abnormality of the eye or its appendages.

drug_authority.value: Topical and oral pharmaceutical agents for examination, management or treatment of eye abnormalities; excludes Schedule I and II controlled substances
drug_authority.quote: "Pharmaceutical agent" means any topical or oral drug used or prescribed by a licensee for the examination, management or treatment of an abnormality, disease or condition of the eye or its appendages, including, without limitation, any analgesic drug subject to the requirements of NRS 636.2882 or added to schedule III, schedule IV or schedule V by the State Board of Pharmacy by regulation pursuant to NRS 453.146. The term does not include any drug or other substance added to schedule I or schedule II by the State Board of Pharmacy pursuant to that section.

surgery_prohibited.quote: The provisions of this section do not authorize an optometrist to engage in any practice which includes: Any procedure using a laser, scalpel, needle or other instrument in which any human tissue is cut, burned or vaporized by incision, injection, ultrasound, laser, infusion, cryotherapy, radiation or other means; or Any procedure using an instrument which requires the closure of human tissue by suture, clamp or similar device.

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: Removing a foreign object from the surface or epithelium of the eye.

value: Closing the lacrimal punctum of the eye
minor_surgical_procedures_authorized.quote: Removing eyelashes with forceps. Closing the lacrimal punctum of the eye.

glaucoma_treatment_authorized.quote: An optometrist shall not treat a person diagnosed with glaucoma unless the optometrist has been issued a certificate by the Board pursuant to NRS 636.2895 or certification by endorsement pursuant to NRS 636.2897.

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: Prescribing, directing the use of or using any optical device in connection with ocular exercises, orthoptics, vision rehabilitation, vision therapy or visual training.

value: Schedule I and II controlled substances prohibited
controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.quote: The term does not include any drug or other substance added to schedule I or schedule II by the State Board of Pharmacy pursuant to that section.

opioid_prescription_day_limit.quote: Prescribes the controlled substance in an amount that does not exceed 90 morphine milligram equivalents per day and will not last more than 72 hours

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: "Pharmaceutical agent" means any topical or oral drug used or prescribed by a licensee for the examination, management or treatment of an abnormality, disease or condition of the eye or its appendages

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: An optometrist shall not administer or prescribe a pharmaceutical agent other than a diagnostic pharmaceutical agent unless the optometrist has obtained a certificate pursuant to NRS 636.288.

pharmacology_training_hours_required.quote: The successful completion of not fewer than 40 hours of clinical training in administering and prescribing pharmaceutical agents in a training program which is conducted by an ophthalmologist and approved by the Board.

supervised_clinical_internship_required.quote: The successful completion of not fewer than 40 hours of clinical training in administering and prescribing pharmaceutical agents in a training program which is conducted by an ophthalmologist and approved by the Board.

referral_to_physician_required.quote: An optometrist, regardless of whether he or she has been issued a certificate to treat persons diagnosed with glaucoma pursuant to NRS 636.2895 or certification by endorsement pursuant to NRS 636.2897, shall refer a patient diagnosed with glaucoma to an ophthalmologist for treatment if any one of the following is applicable: The patient is under 16 years of age. The patient has been diagnosed with any type of glaucoma other than open angle glaucoma. The patient has been diagnosed with acute closed angle glaucoma.

delegation_to_unlicensed_assistants_auth.quote: In any setting where optometry is practiced, an assistant may fit ophthalmic lenses or spectacle lenses if the assistant acts under the direct supervision of a licensed optometrist.

telemedicine_authorized.quote: A licensee may engage in synchronous or asynchronous optometric telemedicine to provide health care services to a patient only if the licensee has completed a comprehensive examination on the patient within the immediately preceding 2 years.

mobile_office_authorized.quote: Notwithstanding any provision of this chapter to the contrary, a licensee, nonprofit or charitable organization, governmental agency or school in this State who obtains a certificate pursuant to this section may own or operate a mobile optometry clinic pursuant to this section.

patient_record_retention_years.quote: each custodian of health care records shall retain the health care records of patients as part of the regularly maintained records of the custodian for 5 years after their receipt or production
